steps.name: Open Local Fixture
steps.goal: Open the local fixture, close the takeover overlay, and confirm the search box is usable.
checks: If blocked, run detect_blocking_overlay then dismiss_blocking_overlay
Ensure search input is visible and interactive

steps.name: Search Restaurants
steps.goal: Type restaurants in marrakech, submit search, and open one restaurant detail page.
checks: Ensure a phone field is visible on details page

steps.name: Extract Phone And Finish
steps.goal: Extract a restaurant phone number, print it in console, and finish only after phone is found.
checks: Use done only when at least one phone candidate exists
Include selected phone number in done.reason
